comments.author: Priya Sharma
comments.body: Sidebar nav mock in the design mock is ready; engineering can start on the pin_order column.

content.text: Sidebar nav mock in the design mock is ready; engineering can start on the pin_order column.

Saved views already live under the board filter menu, but frequent views still take two clicks to reopen. Several design partners asked to pin a view so it appears as a persistent entry under the project sidebar.

Proposal: from the saved-view overflow menu, “Pin to sidebar” stores pin_order on the view record (max 8 pins per user per project). Sidebar shows the pin label; clicking applies the same filter/sort payload as opening the view from the menu. Unpin is available from both sidebar context menu and the view manager.

Acceptance: pinned views survive reload, respect sharing (private pins stay private), and do not appear for users lacking view:read. Reordering pins via drag updates pin_order without changing the underlying query.
